# Hypercap-Case-Definitions

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/Hypercap-Case-Definitions

Purpose: Public repository for Stata analysis code and a Python/Graphviz CONSORT-style diagram supporting the CHEST article "The Consistency of Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure Case Definitions in Electronic Health Record Data."

Primary article:
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chest.2025.08.002
- PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40885535/
- PubMed Central / NLM full text: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12739763/
- Citation: CHEST. 2026;169(1):230-243.

Data boundary:
- Required patient-level input is TriNetX-derived and restricted.
- Expected local input path is data/private/full_db.dta.
- The public repository starts with the prepared full_db.dta and does not reproduce the upstream query, export, code lists, laboratory windows, or analytic-dataset construction.
- The approved restricted input is bound to upstream producer commit 44f49748d415e92b7d50b50d86b8fdea29f6cb07 and observed schema hypercapnia-full-db-v1 through owner-approved historical evidence.
- The historical upstream build did not preserve source-file hashes or clean-worktree attestation and is not reproduced here.
- The hypercap_on_abg and hypercap_resp_failure derivations were separately verified from the approved producer-commit Git object; other upstream variable derivations remain outside the verified scope.
- Do not commit raw data, derived row-level data, local workbooks, generated .dta files, logs, or outputs.
- Use the PMC/NLM article link for accessible article text; do not copy publisher-hosted article text into repository docs.

Workflow:
- Public validation command: make check
- Public diagram command: make diagram-smoke
- Restricted input approval command: make input-approve
- Guarded restricted Stata command: make stata-run
- Restricted comparison command: make stata-compare
- Restricted scientific-correction comparison: make stata-compare COMPARISON_MODE=correction
- Public Python version: 3.11
- Install locked public dependencies with: python3 -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
- The guarded runner accepts INPUT_ROOT, OUTPUT_ROOT, STATA_BIN, RUN_ID, and optional EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256 make variables.
- INPUT_ROOT is the directory containing full_db.dta.
- Before the first run, use APPROVE_RESTRICTED_INPUT=YES with make input-approve to write ignored full_db.manifest.json adjacent to the data; replacing it also requires REPLACE_APPROVED_INPUT=YES.
- make stata-run is the sole supported scientific execution interface. Internal legacy argument handling exists only to interpret preserved historical validation evidence.
- The restricted comparator requires one legacy baseline, two guarded
  candidates from the same nonempty commit whose approval references match the
  current adjacent manifest, and a current input that still matches all three
  run manifests.
- The make diagram-smoke target invokes nbconvert with an explicit notebook output format and the active locked environment's python3 kernelspec.
- The notebook requires the Python graphviz package and the system Graphviz dot executable.
- The notebook renders fixed published counts; it does not derive them from data or validate article estimates.

Key files:
- README.md: human-facing project overview, article links, run commands, license, and data restrictions.
- Hypercapnia Case Definitions.do: Stata workflow for case-definition emulation, agreement analyses, tables, and figures.
- scripts/run_stata.sh and scripts/stata_run.py: restricted-data runner, provenance capture, and output-completeness gate.
- scripts/input_manifest.py: adjacent restricted-input approval and validation.
- scripts/compare_stata_runs.py: baseline-equivalence or correction-impact and candidate-repeatability comparator that suppresses result values.
- stata/: Stata dependency preflight, input-contract validation, and neutral driver.
- Case Definitions Consort.ipynb: Graphviz diagram notebook for the case-definition flow figure.
- data_dictionary.md and data_dictionary.csv: input, derived-variable, and case-definition documentation.
- docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md: public, restricted downstream, and upstream reproducibility boundary.
- docs/VALIDATION.md: sanitized result of the clean legacy-baseline and repeated-candidate restricted validation.
- docs/SCIENTIFIC_ALIGNMENT.md: approved, pending-validation, and unresolved final-article versus current-code decisions.
- metadata/: phenotype approval inventory, upstream dependency record, Stata dependency inventory, and output manifest.
- CITATION.cff: structured repository and article citation metadata.
- AGENTS.md: repo-specific instructions for future coding agents.

Outputs:
- Guarded Stata logs, manifests, copied do-files, tables, figures, and temporary graph files are written under outputs/stata/<run_id>/.
- Generated CONSORT diagram files are written under outputs/figures/.
- Generated outputs are local artifacts and should not be committed to the default branch.

Agent cautions:
- Preserve analysis logic unless explicitly asked to change the scientific methods.
- Preserve the distinction between the six owner-approved simulated phenotype rules and the four unresolved definitions in the phenotype metadata.
- Do not convert blocked, draft, or needs_review variable-level derivations or scientific items to verified without source evidence and owner approval.
- Keep path changes repo-root relative and argument-driven.
- Maintain the data dictionary when adding or renaming variables.
- Validate CITATION.cff after metadata edits.
- Avoid generic "LLM readiness" appendix text; integrate machine-readable information into normal README sections and this llms.txt file.
